senses.gloss: , m. (b. h, Ez. II, 10; = נְהִי) [grief,] woe! oh! Snh. 11ᵃ הי חסיד וכ׳ alas, the pious man (is no more)! (Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ הוֹי).
units: <cite ref="Megillah 28b:12">Meg. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>הי צנא … דחסר</he> (Ms. M. <he>אי</he>, omitting <he>דחסר</he>) alas for the lost basket full of books (dead letter learning)! <cite ref="Megillah 11a:7">Ib. 11ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="F00031"><he>וַי</he></cite>.
